subject: BrightGrid onboarding: PO issuance rollback request and line-item merge
messages:
From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@brightgrid.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightGrid Procurement <procurement@brightgrid.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 15:09:00 -0700
Subject: BrightGrid onboarding: incorrect spend cap + line items to merge

Hi Vivek / Monica,

We completed the onboarding form but flagged two issues after our finance review:

- The spend cap on the submitted onboarding PDF (attached) shows $250,000/year but our SOW indicates a $150,000 committed band.
- Two separate line items for "Redwood API - Inference" (L100) and "Redwood API - Support" (L101) should be merged into a single SKU for billing simplicity.

Can you advise whether you can:
1) Re-issue the provisional PO / purchase token with the corrected spend cap,
2) Collapse the two line items into a single consolidated line (we attached a CSV with the suggested mapping), and
3) Confirm whether that change will require a new PO number or if a rollback + amendment is sufficient?

We're trying to get this reflected before our internal quarter close next week.

Attachments: BrightGrid_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf, proposed_lineitem_merge.csv

Thanks,
Karen Liu
Director, Vendor Ops
BrightGrid
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGrid onboarding: incorrect spend cap + line items to merge

Karen — thanks for the clear summary and attachments. Quick answers up front: we can do a rollback + amendment in most cases (no brand new PO required) and we can merge the two line items into one consolidated billing SKU, but I need procurement to confirm the spend-cap delta and the impact on committed vs metered buckets.

Monica — can you:
- Confirm if the existing provisional PO is still in staging and whether it can be reissued with cap=$150k (instead of $250k).
- If reissue is possible, prepare the amendment text and a redline showing both the old and new line item layout (we'll need this for our accounting and BrightGrid's audit).
- If a rollback is not possible for procedural reasons, flag what triggers creation of a new PO (and estimated turnaround).

Ben — can you sanity-check accounting implications if we reduce the spend cap to $150k (we may need to adjust reserved capacity buckets).

I'll loop back once I have your replies and will include a DocuSign path if a signature is required.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Procurement Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karen Liu <karen.liu@brightgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGrid onboarding: incorrect spend cap + line items to merge

On Mon, Aug 30, 2026 at 5:02 PM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Monica — can you: confirm if the existing provisional PO is still in staging and whether it can be reissued with cap=$150k ...

Quick update from procurement staging: the provisional PO (PR-2026-1987) is still in staging and has not been consumed by billing. We can perform a rollback to the provisioning step and re-issue with the corrected spend cap. Notes and required artifacts below:

Action items (procurement -> operations):
- I will create a PO amendment packet with redline + consolidated line item and submit to Finance for sign-off. (attachment: docuSign_po_adjustment_link.txt)
- The merge will convert L100 + L101 into a single line: L100-MERGED "Redwood API (API + Support)" with combined quantity/price columns.
- Because the original PO hasn't been finalized, we will reuse the PO number after rollback; a brand new PO number will only be issued if the original was already finalized and invoiced.

Ben — finance impact: the reduction from $250k to $150k will move $100k from committed reserve to metered usage. We need your approval for the change to ensure reserved capacity buckets are not overcommitted. If approved, I'll schedule the rollback for tomorrow EOD and kick the DocuSign amendment to BrightGrid for signature.

Karen — estimated timeline if we get finance approval today:
- Today (EOD): rollback + PO amendment prepared and sent to BrightGrid via DocuSign
- Within 48 hours of signed amendment: PO reissued and accounting buckets updated

Attachments: docuSign_po_adjustment_link.txt, proposed_lineitem_merge.csv

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karen Liu <karen.liu@brightgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGrid onboarding: incorrect spend cap + line items to merge

On Mon, Aug 31, 2026 at 9:18 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben — finance impact: the reduction from $250k to $150k will move $100k from committed reserve to metered usage. We need your approval ...

Monica / Vivek — approved.

I confirm Finance will accept the reserve reduction for BrightGrid. Outcomes:
- Approve rollback + amendment; reuse PO number PR-2026-1987 once the DocuSign amendment is executed.
- Approve merged line item L100-MERGED as described. Please ensure the amendment includes: original line values, new consolidated line, and an explicit cap change from $250,000 to $150,000.
- Ops: after amendment is signed, notify Billing and Capacity to move $100k from reserved to metered and update quota tags.

Karen — once signed, please reply-all with the DocuSign confirmation so we can complete the reissue. Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to run through the redline.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
